title: Chapter 7 means test - framework
facts: The bankruptcy means test is used in certain individual Chapter 7 cases primarily involving consumer debts to assess whether granting Chapter 7 relief would be presumptively abusive.
The calculation uses statutory formulas, current monthly income and permitted expense deductions; it is not simply a comparison of annual salary to one national income number.
Median-family-income figures and some expense standards vary by state, household size and effective period and are updated periodically.
Being above the applicable state median does not automatically mean Chapter 7 is impossible; the remaining statutory calculation and circumstances matter.
